entries.zh: 遮阳；遮住日光（用遮阳物挡住太阳）
entries.en: to shade from the sun; to screen off the sun
entries.notes: M 栏多出 chiỗ chiàng 两节，R 栏仅 xīt chiě，四栏未完全对齐；『日遮』之义仍明。

entries.en: to cover, to block off; to screen, to obstruct
to cover and smother a fire; to bank a fire
entries.notes: H 栏作『撏[疑:撏/撑]』，于义无取；M『Iāy』疑为『Tāy』误读，与 R 一致，姑据西语定为捂火。

entries.zh: 如天幕般笼罩；覆盖（自上而下罩住）
entries.en: to overspread; to cover over as the sky does
entries.notes: H『汙[疑:汙/汗]』与覆盖义不合，释义主要据西语词头及 M/R 音读 ō 推定。

entries.zh: 遮盖身体（疑指以兜帽、头巾披覆）
entries.en: to cover the body (with a hood or capelline)
entries.notes: 西语『corpellos Capallina』疑为『los cuerpos, capellina』之讹，H『軀』略合而 M/R 不与，义难定。

entries.zh: 如帐幕（华盖）、围篱般遮盖围合
entries.en: to cover as with a canopy or an enclosure
entries.notes: H『圖』与 M tō、R tǔ 音读相合，但与帐幕围篱之义不合，疑为借字。

entries.en: to cover as with a blanket
entries.notes: H『甲』当为『蓋』之借字（参见第22条『甲被』即蓋被），义据西语定。

entries.zh: 如披风（斗篷）般覆盖、裹住
entries.en: to cover up as with a cloak
entries.notes: H『鉸』与遮盖义不合，R cān 亦与 M âe 不协，仅西语义可据。

entries.en: to cover, to screen
entries.notes: R guiēy 与『蓋』常读不合，然 H『遮蓋』、M chiá cày 与西语互证。

entries.zh: 如屋瓦般覆盖；铺瓦盖顶
entries.en: to cover as roof tiles do; to roof over
entries.notes: H『感伊密』三字不辨其义，释义据西语『如屋顶覆盖』与音写推定。

entries.en: to cover with a shell (or a shell-shaped canopy)
entries.notes: 西语 concha 与 H『牽綉被』、M/R 音写互不相协，姑存疑。

entries.en: to cover with a mantle or coverlet
entries.notes: M 栏尾附『tâ chûĩ quî』与第15条『罩』相重，疑为同源补注。

entries.en: to cover with a cloak
entries.notes: 与第12条同形异读（móa/móā），疑为重复条。

entries.en: to cover with a cloth
entries.notes: 西语 payo 义不明（疑 paño『布』或 palio『华盖』之讹），H 有[疑]，R gūn 与 M guiā 不协。

entries.en: to cover over with a cloth or handkerchief
entries.notes: H 末字[疑:帕/巾]，且西语作 manto 而汉字作『手帕』，义域有差。

entries.en: to have the sky as a covering overhead
entries.notes: H『戴天』为古典语，与『cubrir el cielo』属比喻对应；M 第二音节 tŷ 与『天』常读不合。

entries.en: to embrace, covering with the arms
entries.notes: 西语『a los brincos』疑讹（当作 niños 或 brazos），『懷抱』由 H、M、R 三栏互证。

entries.zh: 掀起又盖回；覆盖与揭开
entries.en: to cover and uncover; to lift up (a cover)
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:衒/衍]，R hiēn 指向『掀』，故定为掀起。

entries.en: to uncover, to lift off
entries.notes: 同第18条，R hiēn 指向『掀』，『落』表揭下。

entries.en: heaven covers the earth (天覆地載)
entries.notes: H 末字[疑:戴/載]，R chây 合『載』，故从『天覆地載』。

entries.en: to cover a grave with lime
entries.notes: R kǔn mūn 疑为『墳墓』，与 H『土墓』、M hōu mōǔ 不全合。

entries.en: to cover with a quilt
entries.notes: 西语作『以手遮盖』，而 H『甲被』、M câ pûe 指向『蓋被』，两说并存。
